evidence.observation: Pressure held at about 2.95–3.01 Torr throughout the ramp, then rose steadily in growth: 3.00, 3.10, 3.15, 3.24, 3.34 Torr (about 0.08 Torr per 120 s)
Argon flow steady at about 100 sccm, so extra inflow from the flow controller does not explain the rise
Temperature settled at the 750 °C setpoint after a small overshoot (760.6 °C at 2520 s); heater power steady at about 45%
No exhaust O2 sensor is installed, so the growth atmosphere cannot be checked with the installed sensors
